sourceTitle: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
originalTitle: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
author: OpenAI

blocks.text: OpenAI and Oracle are bringing Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT and powering new Oracle products and services with OpenAI models and products. Together, we aim to help businesses use AI to run core operations, build better applications, and strengthen security.
blocks.en: OpenAI and Oracle are bringing Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT and powering new Oracle products and services with OpenAI models and products. Together, we aim to help businesses use AI to run core operations, build better applications, and strengthen security.
blocks.zh: OpenAI 与 Oracle 正携手将 Oracle 应用和数据接入 ChatGPT，并利用 OpenAI 模型和产品为 Oracle 的新产品与服务提供支持。我们希望通过合作，帮助企业利用 AI 开展核心业务运营、构建更出色的应用，并加强安全防护。

blocks.text: This builds on our commercial relationship across the OpenAI API, ChatGPT Work, and Codex. Oracle reported 130,000 active ChatGPT users and more than 95,000 active Codex users. Its recruiting team uses ChatGPT Work for market research that once took two to four days to compile, with preparation now taking 15–20 minutes.
blocks.en: This builds on our commercial relationship across the OpenAI API, ChatGPT Work, and Codex. Oracle reported 130,000 active ChatGPT users and more than 95,000 active Codex users. Its recruiting team uses ChatGPT Work for market research that once took two to four days to compile, with preparation now taking 15–20 minutes.
blocks.zh: 此次合作建立在双方围绕 OpenAI API、ChatGPT 工作和 Codex 的商业合作基础之上。Oracle 表示，其内部有 13 万名 ChatGPT 活跃用户和超过 9.5 万名 Codex 活跃用户。其招聘团队使用 ChatGPT 工作开展市场调研，过去需要两到四天才能汇总完成的材料，现在只需 15–20 分钟即可准备好。

blocks.text: OpenAI and Oracle share a vision for an agent-ready enterprise where people and AI agents work across business applications in one connected environment. Our goal is to make Oracle software easier to discover, use, and manage, with simpler administration, unified sign-in, and access governed by each organization’s permissions and approvals. This would help businesses scale AI across core operations and get more value from the software they already use.
blocks.en: OpenAI and Oracle share a vision for an agent-ready enterprise where people and AI agents work across business applications in one connected environment. Our goal is to make Oracle software easier to discover, use, and manage, with simpler administration, unified sign-in, and access governed by each organization’s permissions and approvals. This would help businesses scale AI across core operations and get more value from the software they already use.
blocks.zh: OpenAI 与 Oracle 有着共同的愿景：打造适合智能体开展工作的企业环境，让员工与 AI 智能体能够在互联互通的统一环境中，跨业务应用协同工作。我们的目标是让 Oracle 软件更易于发现、使用和管理，简化管理流程，提供统一登录，并依据各组织的权限设置和审批流程管控访问。这将帮助企业在核心业务运营中规模化应用 AI，并从现有软件中获得更多价值。
在 ChatGPT 中使用 Oracle 开展工作

blocks.text: Oracle is developing Oracle AI Workspace to bring that vision into ChatGPT through integrations with Oracle applications and data. The goal is to let people describe what they need to accomplish, find the right information, and complete approved business workflows in one place.
blocks.en: Oracle is developing Oracle AI Workspace to bring that vision into ChatGPT through integrations with Oracle applications and data. The goal is to let people describe what they need to accomplish, find the right information, and complete approved business workflows in one place.
blocks.zh: Oracle 正在开发 Oracle AI Workspace，通过集成 Oracle 应用和数据，在 ChatGPT 中实现这一愿景。其目标是让用户在同一处描述需要完成的任务、查找相关信息，并执行经批准的业务流程。

blocks.text: For example, a new finance team member could use ChatGPT to investigate costs, understand purchasing decisions, and identify what remains before month-end close. The intended experience would bring information from finance, procurement, and planning applications together, helping more employees use Oracle software within their organization’s permissions and approvals.
blocks.en: For example, a new finance team member could use ChatGPT to investigate costs, understand purchasing decisions, and identify what remains before month-end close. The intended experience would bring information from finance, procurement, and planning applications together, helping more employees use Oracle software within their organization’s permissions and approvals.
blocks.zh: 例如，新加入财务团队的员工可以使用 ChatGPT 核查成本、了解采购决策，并确认月末结账前还有哪些待办事项。按照这一设想，财务、采购和规划应用中的信息将汇集在一起，帮助更多员工在组织的权限和审批范围内使用 Oracle 软件。
将 AI 引入 Oracle 产品

blocks.text: Alongside Oracle AI Workspace, Oracle is announcing updates and new offerings built with OpenAI models and tools:
blocks.en: Alongside Oracle AI Workspace, Oracle is announcing updates and new offerings built with OpenAI models and tools:
blocks.zh: 除了 Oracle AI Workspace，Oracle 还宣布了使用 OpenAI 模型和工具构建的产品更新与新产品：

blocks.text: Oracle AI Security Mesh is designed to help customers find and fix vulnerabilities in applications and infrastructure using OpenAI cyber models. Oracle manages the testing infrastructure, helping customers put these capabilities to work safely and within their authorized scope.
blocks.en: Oracle AI Security Mesh is designed to help customers find and fix vulnerabilities in applications and infrastructure using OpenAI cyber models. Oracle manages the testing infrastructure, helping customers put these capabilities to work safely and within their authorized scope.
blocks.zh: Oracle AI Security Mesh 旨在利用 OpenAI 网络安全模型，帮助客户发现并修复应用和基础设施中的漏洞。Oracle 负责管理测试基础设施，帮助客户在授权范围内安全地运用这些能力。

blocks.text: Oracle AI SMB Bundle combines ChatGPT Business and Codex with Oracle applications and recurring Oracle Cloud Infrastructure credits to help small businesses build products and manage operations.
blocks.en: Oracle AI SMB Bundle combines ChatGPT Business and Codex with Oracle applications and recurring Oracle Cloud Infrastructure credits to help small businesses build products and manage operations.
blocks.zh: Oracle AI SMB Bundle 将 ChatGPT Business 和 Codex 与 Oracle 应用及定期提供的 Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 额度相结合，帮助小型企业构建产品和管理运营。

blocks.text: Oracle App Composer is designed to help teams build apps with Codex and other AI tools, connect them to approved Oracle data and workflows, and share them across their organization. Oracle manages deployment on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, with company permissions and access controls built in.
blocks.en: Oracle App Composer is designed to help teams build apps with Codex and other AI tools, connect them to approved Oracle data and workflows, and share them across their organization. Oracle manages deployment on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, with company permissions and access controls built in.
blocks.zh: Oracle App Composer 旨在帮助团队利用 Codex 和其他 AI 工具构建应用，将应用连接到获准使用的 Oracle 数据和工作流，并在组织内部共享。Oracle 负责管理这些应用在 Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 上的部署，并内置企业权限和访问控制。
通过 Oracle Marketplace 获取 OpenAI 产品与服务

blocks.text: Oracle customers in the U.S. can purchase access to the OpenAI API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work through Oracle Marketplace, using existing procurement processes and eligible Oracle Universal Credits.
blocks.en: Oracle customers in the U.S. can purchase access to the OpenAI API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work through Oracle Marketplace, using existing procurement processes and eligible Oracle Universal Credits.
blocks.zh: 美国的 Oracle 客户可以沿用现有采购流程，使用符合条件的 Oracle Universal Credits，通过 Oracle Marketplace 购买 OpenAI API、Codex 和 ChatGPT 工作的使用权限。

blocks.text: Learn more about the OpenAI and Oracle partnership.
blocks.en: Learn more about the OpenAI and Oracle partnership.
blocks.zh: 进一步了解 OpenAI 与 Oracle 的合作关系。
